Corollary
[closed simply connected constant curvature]

Source: petersen:page-0217 ↗ thm:pet-ch5-monodromy-theorem 1. ch5:5.6.12If $M$ is closed and simply connected with constant curvature $k$, then $k>0$ and $M=S^n$; in particular $S^p\times S^q$ and $\mathbb {CP}^n$ admit no constant-curvature metric.
Proof

↗ cor:pet-ch5-closed-simply-connected-constant-curvature \sketch Compactness gives completeness by section 2, so subsection 6.2 identifies $M$ with $S_k^n$. This space is compact only for $k>0$, when it is a rescaled round sphere.

□
